name: Summer Academy for Math and Science (SAMS)
what_you_do: Six weeks on the CMU campus taking math and science courses, doing a STEM research project, and getting college application help. Fully funded and merit based.
who_can_apply: Students at least 16 years old by the program start who are U.S. citizens or permanent residents and in 11th grade when they apply. The program focuses on students underrepresented in STEM.
pay_detail: No cost to scholars beyond travel to and from Pittsburgh
duration: 6 weeks in person, June 26 to August 7, 2027, plus a short virtual jumpstart June 21 and 22, 2027
deadline_text: Application opens December 1, 2026. Deadline February 1, 2027 (decisions April 1, 2027).
how_to_apply: Apply online through the CMU Pre-College application portal from December 1, 2026 to February 1, 2027. Residential only; scholars must attend the full program.
notes: The apply portal could not be read, it needs JavaScript. Competitive and limited spots. Scholars cannot take other summer programs that overlap. Questions: cmu-sams@andrew.cmu.edu.
